Name: Legendary Scarecrows
Author: ELocket
Description:
Now you too can have the likes of Michael Myers or Jason guarding your precious crops!
[img]https://i.imgur.com/bmXhc7L.jpg[/img]



[size=5]Install[/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Install Content Patcher[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]

Downloads.Description: A mod that replaces 4 scarecrows with Jason, Chucky, Freddy, and Michael Myers. 1.1 update now adds custom description for each changed scarecrow.
